abstract: The development of an angiosarcomatous component in germ cell tumors is rare. Here we studied 12 cases of mediastinal germ cell tumors with an angiosarcomatous component. All patients were men with a mean age of 34 years (range, 24-49 years). No patient had a documented testicular germ cell tumor. The mean size of mediastinal tumors was 12.9 cm (range, 5.5-16.0 cm). Grossly, the tumors were cystic with variegated hemorrhagic, mucinous, and fleshy solid areas. Microscopically, all tumors were composed of germ cell tumor. The most common germ cell tumor component was teratoma (n = 10); and other germ cell tumor components included seminoma (n = 3), yolk sac tumor (n = 3), embryonal carcinoma (n = 2), and choriocarcinoma (n = 1). The angiosarcomatous component was present in primary mediastinal tumors (n = 6), metastasis (n = 3), or both primary mediastinal tumor and metastasis (n = 3). The angiosarcomatous component accounted for an average of 30% (range, 5%-95%) of the primary mediastinal tumor. In addition, other non-germ cell components, including rhabdomyosarcoma (n = 3), leiomyosarcoma (n = 1), and poorly differentiated carcinoma (n = 1), were also present in the tumors. Of the 10 patients with follow-up available, all patients developed metastasis (n = 8) or local recurrence (n = 2); 7 died of disease at a mean of 33 months (range, 21-75 months), and 3 patients were alive at a mean of 75 months (range, 5-120 months). Our findings suggest that the presence of an angiosarcomatous component in mediastinal germ cell tumor, even in a small amount, is associated with a poor clinical outcome.
abstract_ja: 血管肉腫様成分は胚細胞腫瘍ではまれにしか生じない。今回、血管肉腫様成分を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍12例を検討した。全例男性で、平均年齢は34歳(範囲24〜49歳)であった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある患者はいなかった。縦隔腫瘍の平均径は12.9cm(範囲5.5〜16.0cm)であった。肉眼的に、腫瘍は嚢胞状で、出血性、粘液性、充実性の部分が混在していた。組織学的には、全例が胚細胞腫瘍から成っていた。最も多い胚細胞腫瘍成分は奇形腫(10例)であり、その他の成分はセミノーマ(3例)、卵黄嚢腫瘍(3例)、胎児性癌(2例)、絨毛癌(1例)であった。血管肉腫様成分は、原発性縦隔腫瘍のみ(6例)、転移のみ(3例)、または原発と転移の両方(3例)に認められた。血管肉腫様成分は原発性縦隔腫瘍の平均30%(範囲5〜95%)を占めた。追跡可能な10例では全例に転移(8例)または局所再発(2例)がみられた。7例は平均33か月(範囲21〜75か月)で原病死し、3例は平均75か月(範囲5〜120か月)で生存していた。本研究は、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍における血管肉腫様成分が、たとえ少量であっても予後不良と関連することを示唆する。
